## Outcome

What user-observable result does this change produce?

## Scope

What changed, and what intentionally did not change?

## Proof

Map each material claim to the command, test, rendered observation, or other direct evidence that supports it.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No raw private conversations, secrets, credentials, or personal data were added.
- [ ] Package versions and duplicated metadata remain synchronized.
- [ ] New behavior has a deterministic test or evaluation case where practical.
- [ ] Documentation claims do not exceed the evidence.
